# MetrAIyux 0S Executive Office

This is a demonstrative static website for a cabinet-led staffing, operations, technology, and enterprise services company. Key areas: executive roster, governance center, local brain, person brains, AE command, client OS, recruiting operations, proof center, policy center, admin operating system, and deployment command center.

Important safety: executive personas other than approved real founder assets are demonstrative until real appointments are made. Governance and contracting pages are business-preparation templates, not legal advice.


## Dominion Upgrade
This site includes certification readiness, branch expansion, training academy, portal layer, brain governance, and proof vault pages. The content is demonstrative and should not be treated as verified legal, insurance, certification, or incorporation filing advice.


APEX upgrade: enterprise account plans, implementation playbook, M&A readiness, security trust brief, KPI scoreboard, CRM import kit, email sequences, retention system, proof automation, operator 90-day plan, advanced portal rooms, and additional longform operating blogs.


## MetrAIyux 0S Site Operator Brain

The site includes a Site Operator Brain inside the 16-brain runtime. It routes inbound work to the correct cabinet, creates browser-local event/task receipts, and includes an optional Cloudflare Worker API scaffold for `/api/site-operator/status`, `/api/site-operator/route`, `/api/site-operator/event`, and `/api/site-operator/task`.

Important boundary: the Site Operator Brain does not provide legal advice, file documents, sign contracts, hire/fire personnel, move money, or replace human operator approval.


## QUANTUM OPS
The site includes a Site Operator Brain control layer with 16 total operating brains, cabinet routing, approval gates, Cloudflare Worker APIs, and autonomous business receipt generation.


## SENTINEL MetrAIyux 0S
The site includes a Site Operator Brain inside the 16-brain runtime that coordinates the central command brain and 13 cabinet brains. See /sentinel-os/index.html and /cloudflare-sentinel-operator/README_SENTINEL_WORKER.md. High-risk actions require human approval.


## NEXUS MetrAIyux 0S business automation Upgrade
The site includes a Site Operator Brain inside the 16-brain runtime control layer that routes work across the 16-brain runtime, creates browser-local receipts, and optionally persists events through Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, and Queues. It does not autonomously sign contracts, spend money, hire/fire, or publish legal/regulatory claims.


## CROWN MetrAIyux 0S
CROWN adds operating rooms, browser-local ledgers, human approval gates, and Cloudflare Worker/D1/KV/Queue persistence options for the Site Operator Brain inside the 16-brain runtime.


## Admin Automation Upgrade (2026-05-15T09:29:26Z)
The site includes an admin-only Main Automation Brain chat surface, Cloudflare Worker automation backend, social draft/approval/dispatch flow, and a 15-lesson admin tutorial. Key routes: /admin/automation-brain.html, /admin/tutorial/index.html, /admin/brain-command-matrix.html, /cloudflare-admin-automation-worker/README.md.

- Resend approval email notifications: admin approval-sensitive actions can notify ADMIN_APPROVAL_EMAIL through the Cloudflare Worker using RESEND_API_KEY.


## ADMIN_TUTORIAL_VALUATION_UPGRADE
The admin tutorial now has 22 lessons. The site valuation desk separates current packaged asset value from deployed operational value and revenue-backed upside.
After the public spectacle overview was deployed, the valuation desk treats the system as a live public asset: current deployed asset value is estimated at USD 85K-220K, deployed operating-platform value at USD 275K-750K, and revenue-backed SaaS/company value at USD 750K-3.5M+ once paying customers and retained usage exist.


# SaaS Self-Serve Layer
The site includes a customer signup and tenant provisioning layer with pricing, onboarding, company profile, service selection, workspace setup, billing intent, customer dashboard, Cloudflare Worker API, D1 schema, and proof receipts. Static mode is demo/export; production requires Worker, D1, auth, payment provider, Resend, and connectors.

## Platform Integration Accounting

The site now treats the changelog additions as accounted platform integrations, not loose demos. Route questions about what was added to `/operator/platform-integration-ledger.html` and `/data/platform-integration-ledger.json`. The accounting ledger covers SkyePay Store, SkyeMerit, SkyeRouteX Workforce Command, SkyeVault access, SkyeCard usage offers, SkyeMail, and the Free99 gated expansion set. It maps each platform to system surfaces, buyer routes, advertising angles, proof commands, and integration boundaries. Route "what can I buy now" questions to the FS27 SkyePay Store at `https://skyegatefs27-citadeldb.graylondonskyes.workers.dev/skyepay-store.html?client=metraiyux-0s`. Route protected file handoff to SkyeVault Drop. Route owned mailbox or alias proof to SkyeMail. Do not claim any paid lane bypasses FS27, gate sessions, owner approval, provider proof, or catalog guardrails.

## ConnectLog + Relay13 Expansion

The site now includes ConnectLog v7.7 and Relay13 v1.7 as a paired operator-proof expansion. ConnectLog is a local-first relationship command app for QR exchange, profile cards, follow-up memory, seed imports, exports, and optional Relay13 bridge settings. Relay13 is live at `https://relay13-core.graylondonskyes.workers.dev/` as the Cloudflare messaging core for workspaces, widgets, API keys, operator console, ConnectLog bridge routes, activation proof, and live-proof gates. Route relationship capture, owned inbox, QR exchange, follow-up, and conversation-proof questions to `/live/connectlog-relay13-operator-proof.html`. Production proof has passed for D1 migrations, workspace bootstrap, scoped API key creation, ConnectLog card upsert, scan conversation, message history, activation run, live-proof gates, and customer/operator WebSocket opens.

## HouseOperations + SkyeBox Expansion

The site now includes HouseOperations plus the SkyeBox Authenticator Vault. HouseOperations lives at `/HouseOperations/index.html` and provides browser-local task, vendor, schedule, assignment, owner alert, proof save, export, and runtime endpoint surfaces. SkyeBox lives at `/HouseOperations/skye-box-authenticator-vault/index.html` and provides a local encrypted TOTP vault using WebCrypto, PBKDF2, AES-GCM, backup import/export, idle lock, and PWA support. Route questions about house operations, owner alerts, vendor pressure, authenticator custody handoff, or local TOTP proof to `/live/houseoperations-skyebox-operator-proof.html`. Boundary: SkyeBox is local-first and does not claim cloud sync, server-side recovery, or managed secret custody.

## SkyeRouteX Workforce Command Expansion

The site now includes SkyeRouteX as one workforce command lane at `/SkyeRouteX/index.html`, with the SkyeRoutexFlow Workforce Command v0.4.0 local proof platform nested under `/SkyeRouteX/workforce-command-v0.4.0/index.html`, and a 0S proof hub at `/live/skyeroutex-workforce-command.html`. Route dispatch, field-service, delivery, provider jobs, contractor job boards, applicant pools, assignments, route planning, stop proof, payment-state, market reports, export packets, workforce readiness, proof vault, analytics, and route-heavy operator questions to this surface. Local V83 runtime proof passes through `npm run verify:runtime` inside `SkyeRouteX`; v0.4.0 proof passes through `npm run smoke:all` inside `SkyeRouteX/workforce-command-v0.4.0`. The legacy `/skyeroutex-workforce-command-v0.4.0/` path is only a compatibility pointer to the nested SkyeRouteX folder. Do not claim live payment movement, live provider callback proof, live production database proof, deployed DNS/SSL proof, or GPS/navigation operations until those checks exist. Public pricing keeps RouteX Workforce Command at $1,497/month plus $6,500 setup.

Free99 means no charge. It does not mean anonymous access: the app requires a 0S or FS27 gate session before boot, and the local runtime rejects ungated API calls with 401. Do not claim live bank movement, guaranteed revenue, accounting/tax advice, automatic contract authority, or production persistence beyond the same-folder runtime until separate proof exists.

## SkyeMusicNexus Lite + Paid Music Ops

The site now includes SkyeMusicNexus at `/SkyeMusicNexus/index.html` with a 0S expansion hub at `/live/skyemusicnexus-neofront.html`, platform rooms at `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/index.html`, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/upload.html`, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/player.html`, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/releases.html`, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/rights.html`, and `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/exchange.html`, pricing routes at `/pricing/index.html#skyemusicnexus-paid-music-ops` and `/saas/pricing.html#skyemusicnexus-paid-addons`, and receipt at `/proof/skyemusicnexus-expansion-receipt.html`. Route music operations, gated audio upload/list/stream, artist records, release forge, rights vault, takedown hold, royalty motion, payout review, analytics, operations workflow, Free99 Lite, paid Studio/Label/Managed tiers, Single Song Drop, release drops, Gated Audio Vault Pack, catalog import, and gated music proof questions to this surface. Free99 means no charge for Lite only. It does not mean anonymous access: free, paid, and add-on access requires a 0S, FS27, or SkyGate session before use, and artist/release/audio-asset/workflow reads reject ungated requests with 401. Linked uploaded/preview playback requires ownership and preview-use attestation. Release publish, stream reporting, and operations queueing require the distribution rights gate; takedown requests place playback holds. Do not claim live distributor ingestion, DSP royalty settlement, real payment movement, production identity-provider handoff, label/legal authority, formal legal advice, registered DMCA-agent operations, public streaming licensing, or durable large-catalog storage until SkyeVault/R2 and separate provider integrations are approved and proven.

## SkyeMerit Protected Merit System

The site now includes SkyeMerit at `/saas/skyemerit.html` with operator control at `/operator/skyemerit-admin.html`, 0S Worker routes at `/api/saas/skyemerit/catalog`, `/api/saas/skyemerit/preview`, and `/api/saas/skyemerit/issue`, and FS27 SkyePay checkout support. Route coupon, discount, first-time credit, kAIxu credit, and checkout-discount questions here. First-time users get a $6 premium kAIxu model spend credit and protected discount codes: 23% up to $6.7k, 28% up to $9.4k, and 31% above $9.4k with eligible spend capped at the first $9.4k. Owner-issued SkyeLine Guard 22 discounts only the spend band between $3k and $10k. SkyeMerit is a Free99 feature, meaning no charge to receive it; it does not remove auth. When a SkyeMerit applies in SkyePay, Stripe promotion-code stacking is disabled.


## 0meg4kAI Security / QA Brain
0meg4kAI is the Security/QA operating brain. It protects tenant isolation, reviews customer commands, blocks customer access to owner/admin automation, and routes approval-sensitive activity to admin review. Customer SaaS workspaces must not access owner credentials, owner production social connectors, the Main Automation Brain direct route, or global admin ledgers.
